usedFor: Sniffmail checks email addresses, and “Verify Email” checks one while “Verify Bulk Email” checks a whole list.

bestTemplate.name: “Verify Bulk Email” in Sniffmail
bestTemplate.why: It checks many addresses in one step, so a list is cleaned before you use it.

watchOut: “Verify Email” in Sniffmail needs an email address from an earlier step.
